name: Default
shortDescription: Headless GraphQL commerce platform with the Saleor API, a Celery worker, the Dashboard admin UI, PostgreSQL and Valkey.

alerts.message: Sign in to the Dashboard with the superuser created on first start: the email is DJANGO_SUPERUSER_EMAIL and the generated password is DJANGO_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD in the environment settings. The first start runs all database migrations and can take several minutes.
Outgoing email (password resets, staff invites, order notifications) needs an SMTP server: set EMAIL_URL, for example smtp://user:password@smtp.example.com:587/?tls=True.
